study_name: Multi-seed statistical validation and Monte Carlo convergence

seed_generation.method: numpy.random.SeedSequence(master_entropy).spawn(100); each child.generate_state(1,dtype=uint32)[0] converted to the integer seed accepted by the core; all 100 resulting seeds checked unique before sampling.

design.policy: No seed selection, resampling or design changes after results. Strategies share paths; nested sample sizes share prefixes. Coverage is aggregated separately by sample size and channel.
design.storage: Preserve all maximum-size strategy costs and validity masks; store price/innovation SHA256 and seed/config/runtime to regenerate large matrices. Do not store repeated nested samples or all full price matrices.

pairing.interpretation: Independent comparison is an analytic counterfactual at equal per-strategy sample size, not another simulated dataset.

financial_comparison.note: Positive paired mean cost is not evidence of an inferior weighted objective; mean CIs do not quantify objective-difference uncertainty.
